from urllib.error import HTTPError, URLError
from urllib.request import urlopen

codes = ["pae","paf","pag","pah","pai","paj","pak","pal","pam","pan","pao","pap","paq","par","pas","pat","pau","pav","paw","pax","pay","paz"]
with open("pseudomonas_code_scan.tsv", "w", encoding="utf-8") as out:
    out.write("code\tmapping_rows\tPA14_hits\tfirst_mapping\n")
    for code in codes:
        try:
            text = urlopen("https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pathway/" + code, timeout=20).read().decode("utf-8")
            rows = [line for line in text.splitlines() if line]
            hits = [line for line in rows if "PA14_" in line]
            first = rows[0] if rows else ""
            out.write("%s\t%d\t%d\t%s\n" % (code, len(rows), len(hits), first))
        except (HTTPError, URLError, TimeoutError) as exc:
            out.write("%s\tERROR\tERROR\t%s\n" % (code, type(exc).__name__))
PY
